reviewed_by: Claude review of the Agent view drawer removal
reason: The operator pointed out that the Agent view already floats over the chat area, so the conversation-details drawer's Agent view tab (Agent view heading, Pop out, Open in Results, the snapshot explorer) is redundant. ChatWorkspaceDrawer now offers Context, Results and Subagents. AgentViewPanel loses its 'Dock in conversation details' button, agentViewGeometry loses the docked/floating placement preference, and ChatResultStream, which only rendered the docked tab, is deleted with its test and its CSS; AgentViewBody keeps the shared .chat-result-stream-body/-detail rules. SessionsPage drops the placement state, the docked effect and the drawer branch; the composer's Agent view button now always toggles the floating panel, and a saved ?drawer=visuals link opens the floating view and removes the parameter (replace navigation).
exclusions: Full Python, frontend and Playwright suites are excluded. No Python or native tests: no Python or Rust changed. Frontend selects AgentViewPanel.test.tsx, the only structured-result test touching the removed dock and placement code. Playwright selects structured-results (the Agent view journeys, including the rewritten legacy-link, narrowest-view and no-dock tests) and conversation-details (the drawer tabs), and the assistant entries on desktop, mobile-chromium and mobile-webkit because SessionsPage changed; counts overlap where titles match both. No real-Core entry: real-core.spec.ts never referenced the Agent view tab. Locally the assistant desktop run had one failure in 'streaming chat follows the bottom without overriding reader scroll intent', which passed 3/3 on rerun and does not touch this code.
